svg.aria-description: Parcelpoint on AWS: 12 nodes, 15 connections. 17 resources on AWS, nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from Terraform. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret.
svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint on AWS
svg.desc: Parcelpoint on AWS: 12 nodes, 15 connections. 17 resources on AWS, nested in the groups, networks, and subnets that hold them, imported from Terraform. An arrow means one resource refers to another, and its label says how: a role, a private link, logs, or a secret. Nodes: - Account: AWS account - Shipping labels (S3 bucket, label PDFs), storage - Carrier events (SQS queue), queue - parcelpoint (ECS cluster), service - API task definition, service - Worker task definition, service - Virtual network: Parcelpoint VPC (10.20.0.0/16) - parcelpoint-api (Target group 8080), gateway - api (Security group), secret - Public subnet: Public subnet (10.20.1.0/24 eu-west-1a) - parcelpoint-api (Load balancer), gateway - Private subnet: Private subnet (10.20.11.0/24 eu-west-1a) - tracking (DB subnet group), service - Tracking database (RDS postgres db.t4g.medium), database - tracking-api (ECS service FARGATE), service - event-worker (ECS service FARGATE), service Connections: - Tracking database to tracking: db subnet group - parcelpoint-api to api: firewall - parcelpoint-api to parcelpoint-api: HTTPS 443 - API task definition to Tracking database: data - API task definition to Shipping labels: storage - API task definition to Carrier events: messages - Worker task definition to Tracking database: data - Worker task definition to Carrier events: messages - tracking-api to parcelpoint: cluster - tracking-api to API task definition: task definition - tracking-api to api: firewall - parcelpoint-api to tracking-api - event-worker to parcelpoint: cluster - event-worker to Worker task definition: task definition - event-worker to api: firewall
